---
title: "Library - Weapons"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Load shared utilities
source("_common.R")

# Connect to database and load tables
con <- get_db_connection("../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")
tables <- load_item_tables(con)
quests <- dbReadTable(con, "quests")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get available item images to avoid 404s
available_items <- get_available_item_images("../../asset/img/item")

# Define weapon attribute configuration
weapon_attr_config <- list(
  "WeaponType" = list(output_name = "weapon_type", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "WeaponAttackValue" = list(output_name = "attack_value", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "WandAttackStrength" = list(output_name = "wand_attack", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "WeaponDefendValue" = list(output_name = "defense", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "BodyPosition" = list(output_name = "body_position", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "Weight" = list(output_name = "weight", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "Professions" = list(output_name = "professions", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "WandRange" = list(output_name = "wand_range", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "BowRange" = list(output_name = "bow_range", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "ThrowRange" = list(output_name = "throw_range", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "ThrowAttackValue" = list(output_name = "throw_attack", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "ThrowFragility" = list(output_name = "throw_fragility", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "AmmoAttackValue" = list(output_name = "ammo_attack", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "WandAttackVariation" = list(output_name = "wand_variation", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "WandDamageType" = list(output_name = "wand_damage_type", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "MinimumLevel" = list(output_name = "minimum_level", type = "integer", default = 0L)
)

# Process items with parsed attributes and extracted columns
items <- tables$items |>
  add_parsed_attrs() |>
  add_extracted_attrs(weapon_attr_config)

# Prepare lookup tables using shared functions
loot_lookup <- create_loot_lookup(tables$item_loot_sources, tables$creatures)
sell_lookup <- create_sell_lookup(tables$item_prices, tables$npc_locations)
buy_lookup <- create_buy_lookup(tables$item_prices, tables$npc_locations)
quest_lookup <- create_quest_lookup(quests)

# Prepare all weapon data once (do joins and mutations only once)
weapons_data <- items |>
  # Filter for items that are weapons (either have weapon_type or are ammo/bow/wand/throwable)
  filter(!is.na(weapon_type) | grepl("Ammo|Bow|Wand|Throw", flags)) |>
  left_join(loot_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
  left_join(sell_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
  left_join(buy_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
  mutate(
    image = ifelse(
      type_id %in% available_items,
      paste0('<img src="../../asset/img/item/', type_id, '.png" width="32" height="32">'),
      '<span style="display:inline-block;width:32px;height:32px;background:#e0e0e0;border-radius:3px;"></span>'
    ),
    # Categorize weapons by type and flags
    category = case_when(
      weapon_type == 1 ~ "sword",
      weapon_type == 3 ~ "axe",
      weapon_type == 2 ~ "club",
      grepl("Ammo", flags) ~ "ammunition",
      grepl("Bow", flags) ~ "distance",
      grepl("Wand", flags) & professions == 24 ~ "staff",  # Both sorcerer and druid
      grepl("Wand", flags) & professions == 16 ~ "rod",    # Druid only
      grepl("Wand", flags) & professions == 8 ~ "wand",    # Sorcerer only
      grepl("Throw", flags) ~ "throwable",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Attack: use appropriate attack value based on weapon type
    attack = case_when(
      !is.na(attack_value) ~ attack_value,
      !is.na(throw_attack) ~ throw_attack,
      !is.na(ammo_attack) ~ ammo_attack,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # Damage display for wands/rods/staffs (strength ± variation)
    damage_display = ifelse(
      !is.na(wand_attack) & !is.na(wand_variation),
      paste0(wand_attack, " ± ", wand_variation),
      NA_character_
    ),
    hand = ifelse(body_position == 0, "Two-handed", "One-handed"),
    # Range: use appropriate range based on weapon type
    range = case_when(
      !is.na(wand_range) ~ wand_range,
      !is.na(bow_range) ~ bow_range,
      !is.na(throw_range) ~ throw_range,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # Vocation: decode professions for wands/rods/staffs
    vocation = decode_professions(professions),
    # Damage type for wands/rods/staffs
    damage_type = case_when(
      wand_damage_type == 1 ~ "Physical",
      wand_damage_type == 2 ~ "Poison",
      wand_damage_type == 4 ~ "Fire",
      wand_damage_type == 8 ~ "Energy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Break chance for throwables (display as percentage)
    break_chance = ifelse(
      !is.na(throw_fragility),
      paste0(throw_fragility, "%"),
      NA_character_
    ),
    # Level requirement display (only show if > 0)
    level_display = ifelse(minimum_level > 0, minimum_level, NA_integer_),
    description = ifelse(!is.na(description) & description != "", description, ""),
    sell_to = ifelse(!is.na(sell_npc), paste0(sell_npc_html, " (", sell_price, " gp)"), ""),
    buy_from = ifelse(!is.na(buy_npc), paste0(buy_npc_html, " (", buy_price, " gp)"), ""),
    rewarded_from_html = sapply(rewarded_from, function(x) convert_quest_rewards_to_links(x, quest_lookup)),
    lootable_from_html = ifelse(!is.na(lootable_from) & lootable_from != "", lootable_from, "")
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Swords

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

swords <- weapons_data |>
  filter(category == "sword") |>
  select(
    Image = image,
    Name = name,
    Hand = hand,
    Attack = attack,
    Defense = defense,
    Weight = weight,
    Level = level_display,
    Profession = vocation,
    Description = description,
    `Rewarded from` = rewarded_from_html,
    `Lootable from` = lootable_from_html,
    `Sell to` = sell_to,
    `Buy from` = buy_from
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Attack))

create_datatable(swords, image_col_width = "50px")
```
